notes: Sermon extract. Bible Characters (1902) is a multi-author compilation; the Moody section is headed 'Bible Characters described in his soul-winning sermons', and the editor's introduction says he 'culled from their utterances choice selections'. Several pieces are only a page long. No text is stated. Opening words: “Let us go to Carmel for a few minutes. King Ahab had forsaken the God of Israel, and all the court people and “upper ten” had followed his example. But …”
